name: Diurnal-Hoodoo
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by an ancient meteor crater. Beyond tectonic rift valleys, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
Breathable air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on platinum, iron, uranium and geothermal energy are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
